questions.q: What does an embedding model return for a text?
options: A vector: a list of numbers that encodes the meaning
questions.why: An embedding model reads text and returns a vector (1024 numbers with mxbai-embed-large).

questions.q: Why does semantic search find 'refund policy' for 'Can I get my money back?'
options: It uses a dictionary of synonyms
Their vectors are close because their meanings are similar
questions.why: No shared words: the match comes from similar meaning, measured on the vectors.

questions.q: In the lab, 'I love this phone' vs 'I hate this phone' scored 0.66. What does this teach?
options: Embeddings capture the topic more than the opinion; read scores relatively
Cosine similarity only works for single words
questions.why: Same topic, opposite opinions, still a high score. Compare scores, don't read one alone.

questions.q: Which call embeds many texts in one request?
questions.why: embed(List<String>) returns one vector per text, in one call.

questions.q: You embedded your FAQs with model A. Which model must embed the questions?
questions.why: Vectors from different models can't be compared. Same model for documents and questions.

questions.q: What does a vector store keep for each document?
questions.why: PGVector stores content, metadata (JSON) and the embedding in one row.

questions.q: What does similarityThreshold(0.5) do?
options: Drops results with a score below 0.5
questions.why: Off-topic questions (like a cake recipe in the lab) then return an empty list.

questions.q: How do you search only audio products under 100?
questions.why: Filter expressions run on metadata, in a portable syntax translated for each store.

questions.q: You switch from a 768-dimension model to a 1024-dimension model. What happens with the existing PGVector table?
options: Searches fail ('expected 768 dimensions, not 1024'): recreate the table and re-embed
questions.why: The lab hit exactly this error. A model change means re-embedding everything.

questions.q: A user types a filter value that you paste into a filter string. What's the risk?
options: Filter injection, like SQL injection: use FilterExpressionBuilder or validate
questions.why: Never concatenate user input into filter strings.

questions.q: Which interfaces make up the Spring AI ETL pipeline?
questions.why: DocumentReader, DocumentTransformer, DocumentWriter (a VectorStore is a DocumentWriter).

questions.q: What does PagePdfDocumentReader return?
options: One Document for the whole PDF
One Document per page, with the page number in metadata
questions.why: Metadata includes file_name and page_number.

questions.q: Why split documents into chunks before embedding?
options: One topic per vector gives precise matches
questions.why: A whole-document vector mixes every topic and matches poorly.

questions.q: With its default prompt, the small model's keywords started with 'Here are three keywords...'. The fix in the lab?
options: A stricter keywordsTemplate: reply with the keywords only
questions.why: Small models add chatter; a strict prompt fixed it.

questions.q: Running the ingestion twice must not create duplicates. How did the lab handle it?
options: Delete the file's old chunks by filter (file_name in [...]) before adding
questions.why: vectorStore.delete(filter) then vectorStore.add(chunks): still 10 rows after a second run.

questions.q: What are the three steps of RAG?
questions.why: Search the store, add the chunks to the prompt, let the model answer from them.

questions.q: Which advisor lets you plug in query transformers and a custom retriever?
questions.why: It's modular: transformers, expander, retriever, joiner, post-processors, augmenter.

questions.q: No chunk matches the question. With ContextualQueryAugmenter.allowEmptyContext(false), the model...
questions.why: In the lab, the QuestionAnswerAdvisor answered 'Canberra', the modular advisor declined.

questions.q: The lab's first answer was 'the handbook doesn't specify vacation days'. What was the root cause?
options: Retrieval: 'Brightwave' pulled three other chunks; the vacation chunk was 5th with topK 3
questions.why: Logging the retrieved chunks revealed it; topK 5 fixed it.

questions.q: Where do you read the documents the QuestionAnswerAdvisor retrieved?
questions.why: RetrievalAugmentationAdvisor uses RetrievalAugmentationAdvisor.DOCUMENT_CONTEXT.

questions.q: An embedding model is used to...
options: Turn text into vectors that encode meaning

challenge.title: Chat with your own docs
challenge.task: Build GET /ask?q=... that answers questions about a documentation set of your choice (at least one PDF and one Markdown file, 10+ pages in total), stored in PGVector, and returns the answer with its sources (file and page).
requirements: Ingest with readers, a cleaning step, a TokenTextSplitter and file_name metadata; re-running ingestion creates no duplicates
Use a RetrievalAugmentationAdvisor with a VectorStoreDocumentRetriever and allowEmptyContext(false)
Log every retrieved chunk with its score
Write 10 test questions with expected answers (2 of them not covered by the docs) and record the results
Tune topK, the threshold or the chunk size until at least 8 of 10 are correct, and note what you changed
selfCheck: Out-of-scope questions are declined, not answered from memory
You can explain one wrong answer by looking at the retrieved chunks
